All three elements contain the point (500, 400). The z-index values determine the stacking order:
- root>alpha has z-index 2 (paints first, lowest)
- root>gamma has z-index 3 (paints second, middle)
- root>beta has z-index 4 (paints last, highest)

In CSS, higher z-index values paint on top and obscure elements with lower z-index values. Therefore, root>beta with z-index 4 paints last and its background color (#445566) is what the viewer sees at (500, 400).
